answers.q: Can I reuse enrichment logic across multiple tables?
answers.html: Yes. You can create a Function from any set of enrichment columns and instantly reference it across unlimited tables and workbooks.

answers.q: How do I make changes to a Function without breaking live workflows?
answers.html: Functions have a sandboxed edit mode with publish diffs — so you can iterate safely without disrupting anything that's already running.

answers.q: Is there a limit to how many columns I can have in a table?

answers.html: Yes. You can compose Functions from other Functions, making it possible to build layered enrichment workflows that reference each other.

answers.q: How do I know what each Function run is costing me?
answers.html: Functions include full credit cost tracking at every level, so you can see exactly what each run costs across your entire workspace.

answers.q: Do I need a special plan to use Functions?
answers.html: Functions are available on all paid plans both modern (Launch, Growth, Enterprise) and legacy.
